title: Five days in Athens
credits: This is a compilation and summary of one of the most amazing journeys that I have done. In October of I had the opportunity to travel to Greece It was a trip full of emotions and the first step of leaving my country besides It was my first time on another continent I hope I had captured the heat and warmth of Athens
description: This is a compilation and summary of one of the most amazing journeys that I have done. In October of 2022, I had the opportunity to travel to Greece, It was a trip full of emotions and the first step of leaving my country besides It was my first time on another continent, I hope I had captured the heat and warmth of Athens
